summary: V38N — Quick Bill Analysis (Bill Drafts) full backend + frontend verification. All 14 backend pytest cases passed (validation, lifecycle, associate, create-contact, reanalyze, PDF endpoint, delete, tenant scoping). Frontend /bill-quick screen verified via Playwright: header, back button, intro card, 3 upload buttons (luce/gas/telco), Bozze section, draft expansion showing extracted KV rows (Fornitore=Enel Energia, Cliente=Mario Rossi, Importo=128.45, Periodo=Gennaio 2026), Associa modal with 39 contact rows + working search, Crea cliente button visible. Master screen tile 'Analizza bolletta' present. No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3720 associate_bill_draft accepts drafts in any status (pending/analyzing/error) — by design; extracted may be null when associating a still-pending draft. Consumer bills endpoints handle this fine.
server.py:3760 create-contact correctly returns 400 when extracted is missing. Good validation.
server.py:3782-3786 numeric-looking extracted fields (telefono/cf/piva) are cast to str — safe.
server.py:3667 list_bill_drafts hard-filters contact_id:null so associated drafts don't leak back into the drafts list. Correct.
bill-quick.tsx uses testID prefixes consistently (draft-card-*, draft-associate-*, draft-create-contact-*, quick-upload-*, quick-assoc-*). Excellent testability.
seed_data_creation: One draft with label prefix TEST_ was seeded via API for UI testing then cleaned up in teardown. All test data prefixed TEST_ and removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V38N adds a new 'Analizza bolletta' flow that lets a consultant upload a bill PDF WITHOUT selecting a contact first. The relevant backend endpoints are all under /api/bill-drafts (see server.py L3567-3820). The frontend screen is /app/frontend/app/bill-quick.tsx, and a tile linking to it exists in master.tsx L153. Full pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/test_v38n_bill_drafts.py — reuse it for regression.
